description: My personal website, home to my project showcase, links, and a blog where I write about what I'm building and learning. It uses a static site generator pipeline that builds the site automatically before deploying to Github Pages.

title: PixelSketch
description: Digital recreation of a classic mechanical drawing toy. First time experimenting with hardware. From the case to the wiring and code, every part was built by me.

title: AlgoTracker
description: AlgoTracker is a web application designed to collect and display user statistics from a competitive programming platform. It features a scraper that automatically records data to a database 24/7, while also presenting user's stats in a visually engaging format.

title: Mediocre Game with Golf Like Gameplay in Space!
description: A physics-based space puzzle game. Launch the spaceship while avoiding physics objects to land on the planet. Features custom physics engine. Made during Pygame Community Summer Game Jam. The project was later refined and earned a silver medal at the INFOMATRIX 2025 international competition held in Romania.

title: LiquiPy
description: a tool for image mesh editing made using Python, pygame. Made for The Tool Jam 3.
